verses.text: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,
lines: When Israel went out of Egypt,
the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

verses.text: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
lines: The sea saw it, and fled.

verses.text: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
lines: What was it, you sea, that you fled?
You Jordan, that you turned back?

verses.text: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?
lines: You mountains, that you skipped like rams;

verses.text: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
lines: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord,
at the presence of the God of Jacob,

verses.text: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
lines: who turned the rock into a pool of water,
the flint into a spring of waters.
